title: Count Down
reference: repeat 4 { tally_up } repeat 4 { repeat tally { forward } turn_right tally_down }
hints: The crane arm gets shorter: 4, 3, 2, 1. Count up to 4 first.
Fill the tally to 4. Then walk it, turn right and take 1 off, four times.
repeat 4 { tally_up } repeat 4 { repeat tally { forward } turn_right tally_down }

story.intro: PATCH: "The Crane Yard. These crane arms get shorter as you climb. Fill the tally up first, then count it back down."
